Introduction and Background The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Institute for Water Resources (IWR) has been tasked by the USACE to develop and maintain a centralized computer-based system to tabulate waterborne transportation cost structures for coastal deep-draft waterway system projects under Federal sponsorship and jurisdiction of USACE. or Water Resources (IWR) has been tasked by the USACE to develop and maintain a centralized computer-based system to tabulate waterborne transportation cost structures for coastal deep-draft waterway system projects under Federal sponsorship and jurisdiction of USACE. Waterborne transportation cost structures and the differentials therein as derived from or associated with waterway project or plan alternatives serve as the primary basis for estimation of economic benefit(s) and indication(s) for return on investment (ROI) of waterway improvement and maintenance projects.
